storyCards.headline: Roll With The Changes: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Reo Speedwagon's "Roll With The Changes" reached #58 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #58 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 11 weeks on the chart.

Roll With The Changes was released in 1988.
